weaknesses.why: The wind-up warns the target and leaves the shooter exposed, and after the shot the cooldown leaves a window to push.

text.name: Girder-7
text.pitch: A medium Soviet vehicle: The base form: aim for a moment, then fire one heavy round on a cooldown.

signature.name: Furnace Lance
signature.effect: The base form: aim for a moment, then fire one heavy round on a cooldown.

team_play_hook.text: Setup and finisher: a teammate who stuns, slows or pins an enemy sets it up for the shot, or the shot softens a heavy for teammates to finish.

how_it_plays.as_user: Save the shot for the moment that matters: a wounded heavy, an enemy hero, or a squad lined up in a corridor.
how_it_plays.as_target: A visible aim line or charging glow tells you a big shot is coming and from where.
how_it_plays.teammates: Enemies with shields or quick dashes become counter-picks to a power-shot unit.
how_it_plays.tells: From above, a thin aim line or a growing glow on the barrel shows the wind-up and its direction to both teams.
